projects.name: Inbound Excel Loader
projects.summary: A web app which uploads data from Excel files in bulk directly into Business Central, with no manual typing.
projects.impact: Excel files received from OnePlus can now be loaded into BC in bulk, which makes moving each company's data across much faster.

steps.label: Build frontend and connected it to BC Extension

details: Reads Business Central configuration packages in Excel format and loads the data into the right BC tables.
Uses a dedicated Microsoft Entra application with read and write permissions, so uploads run without manual sign-in steps.
Python backend extracts the data and pushes it to BC.
Moved to the company-owned Vercel environment, which reduces our dependency on a third party (Angus).

projects.name: OCR Document Scanner
projects.summary: Reads e-signed MMRP forms automatically and fills in the matching Business Central fields.
projects.impact: Complex MMRP form data goes straight into BC. Staff only check and correct it instead of typing it in.

steps.label: Trained the AI model on labelled data
Move model to company's Azure account
Testing the extension with real data

details: A Business Central extension that uses an Azure Function with Microsoft Document Intelligence.
The model is fully trained and tested, but currently on a personal account. It needs to be transferred to the company's Azure account.
The extension code is written but not yet published.
Document Intelligence is pay-as-you-go, estimated at about CAD 300 per year at our current volume of MMRP documents .
